name: Emmessar Biotech & Nutrition Limited
summary: Emmessar Biotech & Nutrition Ltd. specializes in the creation and distribution of health-related and dietary products. The company's operations are segmented into Healthcare, Fine Chemicals, and income generated from leased property. Its product offerings encompass solutions for dermatological care, general wellness, musculoskeletal support, pain management, and sexual health. Established by Mathurakavi Srinivas Raghavan Ayyangar on March 17, 1992, the firm is headquartered in Mumbai, India.
